description: This file defines the AccountsListViewSmarty class, a custom PHP class extending ListViewSmarty, tailored for rendering and managing the Accounts list view in the SugarCRM framework. It includes methods for building UI actions, handling target list additions, exporting data, and processing list view interactions.

classes.name: AccountsListViewSmarty
classes.description: A PHP class extending ListViewSmarty, customized for the Accounts module list view, managing UI actions, export links, and view processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the list view with target list mode enabled.

methods.name: buildAddAccountContactsToTargetList
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript-triggered link to add selected account contacts to a target list with dynamic form creation and popup.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Overrides parent process method to add extra menu items and handle export access logic.

methods.name: buildActionsLink
methods.description: Overrides parent method to modify the order of action buttons.

methods.name: buildExportLink
methods.description: Creates an export link with additional map link, including access check for export permission.
